lines.text: Imagine having a magic stopwatch that could freeze the entire universe for ten seconds.
You might dream of dodging incoming danger or pulling harmless pranks on your friends.
But real physics would make those ten seconds an absolute nightmare.
If time stopped, light particles called photons would also freeze in mid-air, rendering you completely blind.
Air molecules would lock solid, meaning you couldn't take a breath or even push your body forward.
Sound waves wouldn't vibrate, trapping you in a suffocating, pitch-black void of absolute stillness.
When the ten seconds ticked down, you'd collapse gasping for oxygen, thrilled that time flows again.
